title: 输出变量
problem_statement_md:
给定的程序声明了两个变量：**name** 和 **age** 。

完善代码，输出 "**name** is **age** years old"，其中 **name** 和 **age** 是声明的变量值。
problem_statement_en_md:
[s0l0!-header][h1]Variables[/h1][/s0l0!-header] 

You’re making a contact management system.

The given program declares two variables, [b]name [/b]and [b]age[/b].

Complete the code to output "[b][i]name[/i] is [i]age[/i] years old[/b]", where [b]name[/b] and [b]age[/b] are the declared variable values.
[note]You can add together strings using the + operator. And don't forget about spaces.[/note]
hint_md: 你可以使用`+`运算符将字符串相加。而且不要忘记空格。
